units.Ezekiel 1:1: And it happened in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth of the month, while I was among the captives by the River Chebar: the heavens opened, and I saw visions of God.
units.Ezekiel 1:2: On the fifth of the month—this was the fifth year of King Jehoiakim’s captivity—
units.Ezekiel 1:3: the Lord’s word came to Ezekiel son of Buzi, the priest, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Chebar; and the Lord’s hand came upon me,
units.Ezekiel 1:4: and I looked, and behold, a sweeping wind was coming from the north, and a great cloud was within it, with brightness around it and fire flashing like lightning; within it was something like the appearance of electrum, within the fire, and brightness within it.
units.Ezekiel 1:5: And within it was something like a likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: a human likeness was upon them,
units.Ezekiel 1:6: and each had four faces, and each had four wings.
units.Ezekiel 1:7: Their legs were straight, and their feet were winged, with sparks like flashing bronze; and their wings were light.
units.Ezekiel 1:8: A human hand was beneath their wings on their four sides; and the faces of all four of them
units.Ezekiel 1:9: did not turn as they walked; each went straight ahead.
units.Ezekiel 1:10: The likeness of their faces was a human face and a lion’s face on the right for all four, and a calf’s face on the left for all four, and an eagle’s face for all four.
units.Ezekiel 1:11: The wings of all four were stretched out above; each had two joined to one another, and two covered the top of their bodies.
units.Ezekiel 1:12: Each went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit was going, they went and did not turn.
units.Ezekiel 1:13: And amid the living creatures was an appearance like burning coals of fire, like the sight of torches whirling among the living creatures, and brightness of the fire; lightning came out of the fire.
units.Ezekiel 1:15: I looked, and behold, one wheel was on the earth adjoining the four living creatures;
units.Ezekiel 1:16: the appearance of the wheels was like the appearance of tharsis, and all four had one likeness; their workmanship was as though a wheel were within a wheel.
units.Ezekiel 1:17: They went toward their four sides; they did not turn as they went,
units.Ezekiel 1:18: nor did their backs; they were tall, and I saw them. The backs of all four were full of eyes all around.
units.Ezekiel 1:19: When the living creatures went, the wheels moved beside them; when the living creatures rose from the earth, the wheels rose.
units.Ezekiel 1:20: Wherever the cloud was, there was the spirit for movement; the living creatures and the wheels went and rose together with them, because a spirit of life was in the wheels.
units.Ezekiel 1:21: When they went, these went; when they stood, these stood; when they rose from the earth, these rose together with them, because a spirit of life was in the wheels.
units.Ezekiel 1:22: Above the living creatures’ heads was a likeness as of a firmament, like the appearance of crystal, stretched out above their wings;
units.Ezekiel 1:23: and beneath the firmament their wings were stretched out, fluttering one toward another; each had two joined together, covering their bodies.
units.Ezekiel 1:24: As they went, I heard the sound of their wings like the sound of much water; when they stood, their wings came to rest.
units.Ezekiel 1:25: And behold, a voice came from above the firmament that was over their heads.
units.Ezekiel 1:26: Like the appearance of a sapphire stone was the likeness of a throne upon it; and above the likeness of the throne was a likeness like the form of a human being.
units.Ezekiel 1:27: I saw something like the sight of electrum from the appearance of a waist upward; and from the appearance of a waist down below I saw something like the appearance of fire, with its brightness all around.
units.Ezekiel 1:28: Like the appearance of a bow when it is in the cloud on a rainy day, so was the arrangement of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the Lord’s glory. I saw it, and I fall upon my face, and I heard the voice of One speaking.
units.Ezekiel 2:1: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak to you.”
units.Ezekiel 2:2: A spirit came upon me, took me up, raised me, and set me on my feet; I heard Him speaking to me,
units.Ezekiel 2:3: and He said to me, “Son of man, I am sending you out to the house of Israel, those who embitter Me, who have embittered Me, they and their fathers, until this present day,
units.Ezekiel 2:4: and you will say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord.’
units.Ezekiel 2:5: If indeed they listen or are terrified—for it is an embittering house—they will know that you are a prophet among them.
units.Ezekiel 2:6: And you, son of man, do not fear them or be shaken before their faces, because they will rage and gather against you all around, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not fear their words or be shaken before their faces, for it is an embittering house.
units.Ezekiel 2:7: You will speak My words to them, if indeed they listen or are terrified, for it is an embittering house.
units.Ezekiel 2:8: And you, son of man, hear the One speaking to you. Do not become embittering like the embittering house. Open your mouth wide and eat what I give you.”
units.Ezekiel 2:9: I looked, and behold, a hand was stretched toward me, and in it was a scroll of a book;
units.Ezekiel 2:10: and He unrolled it before me. It had writing on the back and the front, and upon it were written a lament, a song and woe.
units.Ezekiel 3:1: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll, then go and speak to the sons of Israel.”
units.Ezekiel 3:2: I opened my mouth wide, and He fed me the scroll.
units.Ezekiel 3:3: He said to me, “Son of man, your mouth will eat, and your belly will be filled with this scroll that has been given to you.” I ate it, and in my mouth it became like sweet honey.
units.Ezekiel 3:4: He said to me, “Son of man, go, enter the house of Israel, and speak My words to them;
units.Ezekiel 3:5: for you are not sent out to a people of deep speech and heavy tongue, but to the house of Israel,
units.Ezekiel 3:6: nor to many peoples of foreign speech or foreign tongues, nor those strong in tongue whose words you will not understand. If I had sent you to such people, they would have listened to you.
units.Ezekiel 3:7: But the house of Israel certainly will not be willing to listen to you, because they do not wish to listen to Me; the entire house of Israel is contentious and hard-hearted.
units.Ezekiel 3:8: Behold, I have made your face strong against their faces, and I will strengthen your contention against their contention,
units.Ezekiel 3:9: and it will always be stronger than rock. Do not fear them or be terrified before their faces, for it is an embittering house.”
units.Ezekiel 3:10: He said to me, “Son of man, take into your heart all the words that I have spoken with you, and hear with your ears,
units.Ezekiel 3:11: and go, enter the captivity, to the sons of your people; you will speak to them and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord,’ if indeed they listen, if indeed they yield.”
units.Ezekiel 3:12: A spirit took me up, and I heard behind me the sound of a great shaking: “Blessed be the Lord’s glory from His place!”
units.Ezekiel 3:13: I saw the sound of the living creatures’ wings fluttering one toward another, and the sound of the wheels adjoining them, and the sound of the shaking.
units.Ezekiel 3:14: The spirit raised me and took me up. I went, impelled by my spirit, and the Lord’s hand came strongly upon me.
units.Ezekiel 3:15: I entered the captivity aloft and went around those dwelling by the River Chebar, those who were there; I sat there seven days, living among them.
units.Ezekiel 3:16: After the seven days, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 3:17: “Son of man, I have appointed you a watchman for the house of Israel. You will hear a word from My mouth and convey My warning to them.
units.Ezekiel 3:18: When I say to the lawless person, ‘You will surely be put to death,’ and you do not warn him or speak to warn the lawless person to turn from his ways so that he may live, that lawless person will die in his injustice; but I will require his blood from your hand.
units.Ezekiel 3:19: But if you warn the lawless person and he does not turn from his lawlessness and his way, that lawless person will die in his injustice, while you will rescue your life.
units.Ezekiel 3:20: When a righteous person turns from his righteous deeds and commits a transgression, and I place torment before his face, he will die because you did not warn him. He will die in his sins, because the righteous deeds he did certainly will not be remembered, and I will require his blood from your hand.
units.Ezekiel 3:21: But if you warn the righteous person not to sin, and he does not sin, the righteous person will surely live because you warned him; and you will rescue your own life.”
units.Ezekiel 3:22: The Lord’s hand came upon me, and He said to me, “Rise and go out to the plain, and you will be spoken to there.”
units.Ezekiel 3:23: I rose and went out to the plain, and behold, the Lord’s glory stood there, like the vision and like the glory I had seen by the River Chebar; and I fall upon my face.
units.Ezekiel 3:24: A spirit came upon me and set me on my feet. He spoke to me and said to me, “Go, be shut inside your house.
units.Ezekiel 3:25: And you, son of man, behold, bonds have been placed upon you, and they will bind you with them; you certainly will not go out from among them.
units.Ezekiel 3:26: I will bind your tongue, and you will become mute; you will not be a man rebuking them, for it is an embittering house.
units.Ezekiel 3:27: But when I speak to you, I will open your mouth, and you will say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: Let the one who hears hear, and let the one who disobeys disobey,’ for it is an embittering house.”
units.Ezekiel 4:1: “And you, son of man, take a brick, set it before your face, and draw upon it a city—Jerusalem;
units.Ezekiel 4:2: lay siege to it, build forward defenses against it, throw up a palisade against it, set camps against it, and arrange missile positions all around.
units.Ezekiel 4:3: Take an iron pan and place it as an iron wall between you and the city. Prepare your face against it; it will be besieged, and you will besiege it. This is a sign for the sons of Israel.
units.Ezekiel 4:4: Lie on your left side and place the injustices of the house of Israel upon it, according to the number of days—one hundred fifty—that you lie upon it; bear their injustices.
units.Ezekiel 4:5: I have assigned you their two injustices as a number of days, one hundred ninety days; bear the injustices of the house of Israel
units.Ezekiel 4:6: and complete all these things. Lie on your right side and bear the injustices of the house of Judah forty days. I have appointed you a day for a year.
units.Ezekiel 4:7: Prepare your face against Jerusalem’s siege, strengthen your arm, and prophesy against it.
units.Ezekiel 4:8: Behold, I have placed bonds upon you; do not turn from side to side until the days of your confinement are completed.
units.Ezekiel 4:9: Take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet and spelt; put them in one earthen vessel and make loaves from them for yourself. According to the number of days you sleep on your side, you will eat them one hundred ninety days.
units.Ezekiel 4:10: The food you are to eat will be weighed out: twenty shekels a day; eat it from time to time.
units.Ezekiel 4:11: Drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin; drink it from time to time.
units.Ezekiel 4:12: Eat it as a barley cake baked in embers; bake it in pellets of human dung before their eyes,
units.Ezekiel 4:13: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: So the sons of Israel will eat unclean things among the nations.’”
units.Ezekiel 4:14: I said, “By no means, Lord, God of Israel! Behold, my life has not been defiled with uncleanness. From my birth until now I have eaten neither what died of itself nor what a wild animal killed, nor has any stale meat entered my mouth.”
units.Ezekiel 4:15: He said to me, “Behold, I have given you cattle dung instead of human dung; prepare your loaves over it.”
units.Ezekiel 4:16: He said to me, “Son of man, behold, I am breaking the support of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight and in need, and drink water by measure and in devastation,
units.Ezekiel 4:17: so that they become needy for bread and water. A man and his brother will disappear, and they will waste away in their injustices.
units.Ezekiel 5:1: “And you, son of man, take a sword sharper than a barber’s razor. Obtain it for yourself and pass it over your head and your beard. Take a balance with weights and divide the hairs;
units.Ezekiel 5:2: burn a quarter with fire inside the city when the days of siege are complete. Take a quarter and burn it up in its midst; cut down a quarter with the sword around it, and scatter a quarter to the wind. I will draw a sword after them.
units.Ezekiel 5:3: Take a few of them in number and gather them into your cloak.
units.Ezekiel 5:4: Take some of these again, cast them into the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it fire will go out. And you will say to the entire house of Israel,
units.Ezekiel 5:5: ‘Thus says the Lord: This is Jerusalem. I have placed her amid the nations, and the lands around her.
units.Ezekiel 5:6: And you will speak My ordinances to the lawless one among the nations, and My laws among the lands around her; for they rejected My ordinances and did not walk in My laws.
units.Ezekiel 5:7: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because your impulse comes from the nations around you, and you have not walked in My laws or performed My ordinances—nor have you even acted according to the ordinances of the nations around you—
units.Ezekiel 5:8: therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, and I will execute judgment in your midst before the nations,
units.Ezekiel 5:9: and I will do among you what I have not done and the like of which I will not do again, according to all your abominations.
units.Ezekiel 5:10: Therefore fathers will eat children in your midst, and children will eat fathers. I will execute judgments against you and scatter all your survivors to every wind.
units.Ezekiel 5:11: Therefore, as I live, says the Lord, surely, because you defiled My holy places with all your abominations, I too will reject you. My eye will not spare, and I too will have no mercy.
units.Ezekiel 5:12: A quarter of you will be consumed by death; a quarter of you will perish by famine within you; a quarter of you I will scatter to every wind; and a quarter of you will fall by the sword around you, and I will draw a sword after them.
units.Ezekiel 5:13: My wrath and My anger against them will be completed, and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken in My jealousy when I complete My anger against them.
units.Ezekiel 5:14: I will make you a wilderness, and your daughters around you, before every passerby;
units.Ezekiel 5:15: you will be mourned and ravaged among the nations around you when I execute judgments against you in the vengeance of My wrath. I, the Lord, have spoken.
units.Ezekiel 5:16: When I send My arrows of famine against them, they will bring exhaustion, and I will break your support of bread.
units.Ezekiel 5:17: I will send famine and harmful wild animals against you, and I will punish you. Death and blood will pass over you, and I will bring a sword upon you all around. I, the Lord, have spoken.’”
units.Ezekiel 6:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 6:2: “Son of man, set your face firmly against the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them,
units.Ezekiel 6:3: and say, ‘Mountains of Israel, hear the Lord’s word. Thus says the Lord to the mountains, hills, ravines and wooded valleys: Behold, I am bringing a sword against you, and your high places will be destroyed,
units.Ezekiel 6:4: and your altars and your sacred precincts will be shattered; I will cast down your wounded before your idols,
units.Ezekiel 6:5: and I will scatter your bones around your altars.
units.Ezekiel 6:6: In all your dwelling territory the cities will be made desolate and the high places will disappear, so that your altars are destroyed, your idols shattered, and your sacred precincts removed;
units.Ezekiel 6:7: wounded people will fall in your midst, and you will recognize that I am the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 6:8: When there are among you survivors of the sword among the nations, and in your scattering in the lands,
units.Ezekiel 6:9: the survivors from among you will remember Me among the nations where they were taken captive. I have sworn against their heart that whores away from Me and their eyes that whore after their pursuits; they will beat their faces over all their abominations.
units.Ezekiel 6:10: They will recognize that I, the Lord, have spoken.
units.Ezekiel 6:11: Thus says the Lord: Clap your hand, stamp your foot, and say, “Aha! Aha!” over all the abominations of the house of Israel; they will fall by sword, death and famine.
units.Ezekiel 6:12: The one near will fall by the sword, the one far away will die by death, and the one enclosed will perish by famine; I will complete My anger against them.
units.Ezekiel 6:13: You will know that I am the Lord when your wounded lie among your idols, around your altars, on every high hill and beneath a shady tree, where they offered a fragrant aroma to all their idols.
units.Ezekiel 6:14: I will stretch out My hand against them and reduce the land to ruin and destruction, from the wilderness of Deblatha, from every dwelling place; you will recognize that I am the Lord.’”
units.Ezekiel 7:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 7:2: “And you, son of man, say, ‘Thus says the Lord to the land of Israel: An end has come; the end has come upon the four wings of the land.
units.Ezekiel 7:4: upon you, inhabitant of the land. The time has come; the day has drawn near, neither with tumult nor with birth pangs.
units.Ezekiel 7:5: Now soon I will pour My anger upon you and complete My wrath in you; I will judge you in your ways and bring all your abominations upon you.
units.Ezekiel 7:6: My eye will not spare, nor will I have mercy; I will bring your ways upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst. You will recognize that I am the Lord who strikes.
units.Ezekiel 7:7: Now the end is upon you. I Myself will send against you and exact retribution upon you in your ways; I will bring all your abominations upon you.
units.Ezekiel 7:8: My eye will not spare you, nor will I have mercy; I will bring your way upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst. You will recognize that I am the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 7:10: Behold, the end has come; behold, the Lord’s day! Even if the rod has blossomed, insolence has risen.
units.Ezekiel 7:11: It will shatter the support of a lawless person, neither with tumult nor with haste.
units.Ezekiel 7:12: The time has come; behold, the day! Let the buyer not rejoice, nor the seller lament;
units.Ezekiel 7:13: for the buyer certainly will no longer return to the seller, and a person will not prevail in the eye of his life.
units.Ezekiel 7:14: Sound the trumpet and judge everything.
units.Ezekiel 7:15: War by the sword is outside, and famine and death inside. The one in the plain will die by the sword, while famine and death will consume those in the city.
units.Ezekiel 7:16: Their survivors will be saved and be on the mountains; I will kill them all, each in his injustices.
units.Ezekiel 7:17: All hands will weaken, and all thighs will be defiled with moisture,
units.Ezekiel 7:18: and they will gird on sackcloth; amazement will cover them, shame will be upon every face among them, and baldness upon every head.
units.Ezekiel 7:19: Their silver will be thrown into the broad streets, and their gold will be disregarded. Their lives certainly will not be satisfied, nor their bellies filled, because it became torment for their injustices.
units.Ezekiel 7:20: They made choice ornaments a source of arrogance and made images of their abominations from them. Therefore I have given them over to them as uncleanness.
units.Ezekiel 7:21: I will hand them into foreigners’ hands to plunder them, and to the pestilent people of the earth as spoils; they will profane them.
units.Ezekiel 7:22: I will turn My face away from them, and they will defile My oversight; they will enter them unguarded and profane them,
units.Ezekiel 7:23: and they will make a confused mixture, because the land is full of peoples and the city full of lawlessness.
units.Ezekiel 7:24: I will turn back the arrogance of their strength, and their holy places will be defiled.
units.Ezekiel 7:25: Propitiation will come and will seek peace, and there will be none.
units.Ezekiel 7:26: Woe upon woe will come, and message upon message; a vision will be sought from a prophet, but law will perish from a priest and counsel from elders.
units.Ezekiel 7:27: A ruler will clothe himself in devastation, and the hands of the people of the land will be paralyzed. According to their ways I will deal with them, and by their judgments I will exact retribution upon them; they will know that I am the Lord.’”
units.Ezekiel 8:1: In the sixth year, in the fifth month, on the fifth of the month, I was sitting in the house, and Judah’s elders were sitting before me. The Lord’s hand came upon me,
units.Ezekiel 8:2: and I saw, and behold, the likeness of a man: from His waist downward, fire, and from His waist upward, like the appearance of electrum.
units.Ezekiel 8:3: He stretched out the likeness of a hand and lifted me by the crown of my head. A spirit lifted me between earth and heaven and brought me to Jerusalem in a vision of God, to the entrance of the inner gate facing north, where the pillar of the one acquiring stood.
units.Ezekiel 8:4: And behold, the glory of the Lord God of Israel was there, in accordance with the vision I had seen in the plain.
units.Ezekiel 8:5: He said to me, “Son of man, look up with your eyes toward the north.” I looked up with my eyes toward the north, and behold, from the north to the gate toward the east.
units.Ezekiel 8:6: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what these people do? They commit great lawlessness here, to keep away from My holy places. You will yet see greater lawlessness.”
units.Ezekiel 8:7: He brought me to the courtyard entrance
units.Ezekiel 8:8: and said to me, “Son of man, dig.” I dug, and behold, there was a door.
units.Ezekiel 8:9: He said to me, “Go in and see the lawlessness these people are committing here.”
units.Ezekiel 8:10: I went in and saw, and behold, vain abominations and all the idols of the house of Israel were drawn upon it all around,
units.Ezekiel 8:11: and there were seventy men from the elders of the house of Israel. Jaazaniah son of Shaphan stood among them before their faces; each had his censer in his hand, and the vapor of incense rose.
units.Ezekiel 8:12: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do, each in their hidden bedchamber? For they said, ‘The Lord does not see; the Lord has abandoned the land.’”
units.Ezekiel 8:13: He said to me, “You will yet see greater lawlessness that these people are committing.”
units.Ezekiel 8:14: He brought me to the entrance of the gate of the Lord’s house facing north, and behold, women were sitting there lamenting Tammuz,
units.Ezekiel 8:15: and He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen? You will yet see practices greater than these.”
units.Ezekiel 8:16: He brought me into the inner court of the Lord’s house, and behold, at the entrance of the Lord’s temple, between the porches and the altar, were about twenty men, their backs toward the Lord’s temple and their faces opposite. These were bowing to the sun.
units.Ezekiel 8:17: He said to me, “Have you seen, son of man? Is it a small thing for the house of Judah to commit the lawlessness they have committed here? For they have filled the land with lawlessness, and behold, they are as though sneering.
units.Ezekiel 8:18: I too will act toward them in wrath. My eye will not spare, nor will I have mercy.”
units.Ezekiel 10:1: I saw, and behold, above the firmament over the cherubim’s head was something like sapphire stone, a throne’s likeness above them.
units.Ezekiel 10:2: He said to the man wearing the robe, “Go in among the wheels beneath the cherubim, fill your hands with burning coals from among the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” He went in before me.
units.Ezekiel 10:3: The cherubim stood to the right of the house as the man entered, and the cloud filled the inner court.
units.Ezekiel 10:4: The Lord’s glory departed from the cherubim to the forecourt of the house. The cloud filled the house, and the court filled with the radiance of the Lord’s glory.
units.Ezekiel 10:5: The sound of the cherubim’s wings was heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Shaddai speaking.
units.Ezekiel 10:6: When He commanded the man wearing the holy robe, saying, “Take fire from among the wheels, from among the cherubim,” he entered and stood beside the wheels,
units.Ezekiel 10:7: and he stretched out his hand into the midst of the fire among the cherubim, took it and gave it into the hands of the man wearing the holy robe. He took it and went out.
units.Ezekiel 10:8: I saw the cherubim, the likeness of human hands beneath their wings.
units.Ezekiel 10:9: I saw, and behold, four wheels stood beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub. The wheels’ appearance was like the appearance of a carbuncle stone.
units.Ezekiel 10:10: Their appearance was one likeness for all four, as when a wheel is within a wheel.
units.Ezekiel 10:11: As they went, they went toward their four directions; they did not turn as they went. For wherever the one leading part looked, they went, and they did not turn as they went.
units.Ezekiel 10:12: Their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels were full of eyes all around, upon their four wheels.
units.Ezekiel 10:13: These wheels were called “Gelgel” in my hearing.
units.Ezekiel 10:15: The cherubim lifted themselves. This was the living creature I had seen at the river Chebar.
units.Ezekiel 10:16: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them. When the cherubim raised their wings to rise from the earth, their wheels did not turn.
units.Ezekiel 10:17: When they stood, these stood; when they rose, these rose with them, because a spirit of life was in them.
units.Ezekiel 10:18: The Lord’s glory went out from the house and mounted upon the cherubim,
units.Ezekiel 10:19: and the cherubim lifted their wings and rose from the earth before me as they went out, with the wheels beside them. They stood at the entrance of the opposite gate of the Lord’s house, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
units.Ezekiel 10:20: This is the living creature I had seen beneath the God of Israel at the river Chebar, and I knew that it was cherubim.
units.Ezekiel 10:21: Each had four faces, each had eight wings, and the likeness of human hands was beneath their wings.
units.Ezekiel 10:22: As for the likeness of their faces, these are the faces I had seen beneath the glory of the God of Israel at the river Chebar; each of them went straight ahead.
units.Ezekiel 43:1: He led me to the gate facing east and brought me out.
units.Ezekiel 43:2: Look—the glory of the God of Israel was coming by the way of the gate facing east. The sound of the camp was like the sound of many redoubling their sound, and the earth flashed like radiance from the glory all around.
units.Ezekiel 43:3: The vision I saw was like the vision I had seen when I was entering to anoint the city; and the vision of the chariot I saw was like the vision I had seen by the River Chobar. I fall on my face.
units.Ezekiel 43:4: The glory of the Lord entered the house by the way of the gate facing east.
units.Ezekiel 43:5: A spirit lifted me and brought me into the inner court. Look—the house was full of the glory of the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 33:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 33:2: “Son of man, speak to your people’s sons and say to them, ‘If I bring a sword upon a land, and the land’s people take one man from among themselves and appoint him as their watchman,
units.Ezekiel 33:3: and he sees the sword coming upon the land, sounds the trumpet and signals to the people,
units.Ezekiel 33:4: and a hearer hears the trumpet’s sound but does not take care, and the sword comes upon him and overtakes him, his blood will be upon his own head.
units.Ezekiel 33:5: Because he heard the trumpet’s sound and did not take care, his blood will be upon himself. But this one, because he took care, rescued his life.
units.Ezekiel 33:6: If the watchman sees the sword coming but does not signal with the trumpet, and the people do not take care, and the sword comes and takes a life from them, that life was taken because of its own lawlessness, but I will require the blood from the watchman’s hand.’
units.Ezekiel 33:7: And you, son of man, I have appointed you a watchman for Israel’s house, and you will hear a word from My mouth.
units.Ezekiel 33:8: When I say to the sinner, ‘You will surely be put to death,’ and you do not speak so that the impious man may guard himself from his way, that lawless man will die in his lawlessness, but I will require his blood from your hand.
units.Ezekiel 33:9: But if you forewarn the impious man of his way so that he may turn from it and he does not turn from his way, this man will die in his impiety, and you have rescued your own life.
units.Ezekiel 33:10: And you, son of man, say to Israel’s house, ‘You spoke this way: Our wanderings and lawless deeds are upon us, and we waste away in them. How shall we live?’
units.Ezekiel 33:11: Say to them, ‘I live, thus says the Lord: I do not desire the impious man’s death, but rather that he turn from his way and live. Turn back completely from your way! Why are you dying, house of Israel?’
units.Ezekiel 33:12: Say to your people’s sons, ‘A righteous man’s righteousness certainly will not rescue him on the day he wanders, and an impious man’s lawlessness certainly will not harm him on the day he turns from it. A righteous man certainly will not be able to be saved.
units.Ezekiel 33:13: When I speak to the righteous man—this one has trusted in his righteousness, yet commits lawlessness—none of his righteous deeds will ever be remembered. In the injustice he committed, in it he will die.
units.Ezekiel 33:14: When I say to the impious man, “You will surely be put to death,” and he turns from his sin and practices judgment and righteousness,
units.Ezekiel 33:15: and returns a pledge, repays what he seized and walks in the ordinances of life without doing wrong, he will surely live and certainly will not die.
units.Ezekiel 33:16: None of the sins he committed will ever be remembered, because he practiced judgment and righteousness; in these he will live.
units.Ezekiel 33:17: Your people’s sons will say, “The Lord’s way is not straight.” Yet this way of theirs is not straight.
units.Ezekiel 33:18: When a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits lawless deeds, he will die in them.
units.Ezekiel 33:19: When the sinner turns from his lawlessness and practices judgment and righteousness, in these he will live.
units.Ezekiel 33:20: This is what you said: “The Lord’s way is not straight.” I will judge you, each in his ways, house of Israel.’”
units.Isaiah 6:1: In the year that King Oziah died, I saw the Lord seated on a throne, high and lifted up; and the house was full of His glory.
units.Isaiah 6:2: And seraphim stood around Him: each one had six wings, and each one had six wings; with two they covered their faces, and with two they covered their feet, and with two they flew.
units.Isaiah 6:3: And one cried to another, saying: Holy, holy, holy is the Lord Sabaoth; all the earth is full of His glory.
units.Isaiah 6:4: And the lintel was lifted at the sound of their cry, and the house was filled with smoke.
units.Isaiah 6:5: And I said, Woe is me, for I am pierced to the heart! For I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell among a people of unclean lips; and my eyes have seen the King, the Lord Sabaoth.
units.Isaiah 6:6: And one of the seraphim was sent to me, with a coal in his hand that he had taken from the altar with the tongs;
units.Isaiah 6:7: and he touched my mouth and said, Behold, this has touched your lips, and will take away your iniquities and cleanse your sins.
units.Isaiah 6:8: And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go to this people? And I said, Behold, here I am; send me.
units.Isaiah 6:9: And He said, Go, and say to this people: Hearing, you will hear and certainly not understand; and seeing, you will see and certainly not perceive.
units.Isaiah 6:10: For the heart of this people has grown dull, and with their ears they have heard heavily, and they have closed their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and turn, and I will heal them.
units.Isaiah 6:11: And I said, How long, O Lord? And He said: Until cities lie waste, without inhabitants, and houses, without people, and the land is left desolate.
units.Isaiah 6:12: And after these things God will remove people far away; and those who remain will multiply upon the land.
units.Isaiah 6:13: And yet a tenth remains upon it; and again it will be for plunder, as a terebinth, and as an acorn when it falls from its husk.
units.Psalms 17:7: And when I was afflicted, I called upon the Lord and cried out to my God. He heard my voice from His holy temple, and my cry before Him will enter His ears.
units.Psalms 17:8: And the earth was shaken and began to tremble; the foundations of the mountains were troubled and shaken because God was angry with them.
units.Psalms 17:9: Smoke rose in His anger, and fire from His face set things ablaze; coals were kindled from Him.
units.Psalms 17:10: And He bent heaven and came down, and gloom was beneath His feet.
units.Psalms 17:11: And He mounted cherubim and flew; He flew on the wings of winds.
units.Psalms 17:12: And He made darkness His hiding place; His tent was around Him, dark water in clouds of the air.
units.Psalms 17:13: From the far-shining radiance before Him, the clouds passed— hail and coals of fire.
units.Psalms 17:14: And the Lord thundered from heaven, and the Most High gave His voice.
units.Psalms 17:15: And He sent out arrows and scattered them; He multiplied lightning flashes and threw them into turmoil.
units.Psalms 17:16: And the springs of the waters appeared, and the foundations of the inhabited world were uncovered at Thy rebuke, Lord, at the blast of the spirit of Thine anger.
units.Psalms 17:17: He sent from on high and took me; He took me to Himself out of many waters.
units.Daniel 7:9: I watched until thrones were set in place and an Ancient of Days was seated, wearing a covering like snow, with the hair of His head like pure white wool. The throne was like a flame of fire,
units.Daniel 7:10: and a river of fire came out before Him. A thousand thousands attended Him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood beside Him. A court sat, and books were opened.
units.Daniel 7:11: Then I watched the sound of the great words the horn was speaking. The beast was beaten to death, its body perished, and it was given over to burning fire.
units.Daniel 7:12: He removed those around it from their authority, and a span of life was given them for a time and a season.
units.Daniel 7:13: I watched in the night vision, and there, upon the clouds of heaven, one like a son of man was coming. He was present as an Ancient of Days, and those standing by were present with him.
units.Daniel 7:14: Authority was given him, and all the nations of the earth according to their families, and all glory, worshipped him. His authority is everlasting authority that will never be taken away, and his kingdom will never be destroyed.
units.Daniel 10:1: In the first year of Cyrus, king of the Persians, a command was shown to Daniel, whose name was called Baltasar. The vision and command were true, and the strong multitude will understand the command; I understood it in a vision.
units.Daniel 10:2: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning for three weeks.
units.Daniel 10:3: I ate no desirable bread; meat and wine did not enter my mouth, and I did not anoint myself with oil until I completed the three weeks of days.
units.Daniel 10:4: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was on the bank of the great river, the Tigris,
units.Daniel 10:5: and I lifted my eyes and saw a man clothed in fine linen, with fine linen wrapped around his waist, and light coming from his middle.
units.Daniel 10:6: His body was like a tarshish stone, his face like a flash of lightning, his eyes like flaming torches, his arms and feet like flashing bronze, and the sound of his speech like the sound of an uproar.
units.Daniel 10:7: I, Daniel, saw this great vision, but the men with me did not see it. Strong fear fell upon them, and they fled in haste.
units.Daniel 10:8: I was left alone and saw this great vision. No strength remained in me; a spirit turned upon me for destruction, and I had no strength.
units.Daniel 10:9: I did not hear the sound of his speech; I had fallen face down upon the earth.
units.Daniel 10:10: He brought a hand toward me and raised me upon my knees, upon the soles of my feet.
units.Daniel 10:11: He said to me, “Daniel, you are a man worthy of pity. Understand the commands I speak to you, and stand in your place, for I have just been sent to you.” As he spoke this command with me, I stood trembling.
units.Daniel 10:12: He said to me, “Do not fear, Daniel. From the first day you set your face to understand and humble yourself before the Lord your God, your word was heard, and I entered because of your word.
units.Daniel 10:13: The general of the king of the Persians stood against me for twenty-one days. Then Michael, one of the foremost rulers, came to help me, and I left him there with the general of the king of the Persians.”
units.Daniel 10:14: He said to me, “I came to show you what will meet your people in the latter days, for the vision is still for days to come.”
units.Daniel 10:15: As he spoke these commands with me, I set my face toward the earth and fell silent.
units.Daniel 10:16: Something like a human hand touched my lips. I opened my mouth, spoke, and said to the one standing opposite me, “My lord, something like a vision turned upon my side, upon me, and there was no strength in me.
units.Daniel 10:17: How can the servant speak with his lord? I have become weak; there is no strength in me, and no breath was left in me.”
units.Daniel 10:18: Again one with a human appearance touched me and strengthened me,
units.Daniel 10:19: and said to me, “You are a man worthy of pity. Do not fear; be well. Take courage and be strong.” As he spoke with me, I became strong and said, “Let my lord speak, for he has strengthened me.”
units.Exodus 24:9: Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s council of elders went up,
units.Exodus 24:10: and they saw the place where the God of Israel stood. What was beneath His feet was like sapphire brickwork, like the appearance of the firmament of heaven in its clarity.
units.Exodus 24:11: Not one of Israel’s chosen men was missing. They appeared in the place of God, and ate and drank.
units.Exodus 24:12: And the Lord said to Moses, “Come up to Me into the mountain, and remain there; and I will give you the tablets of stone, the law and the commandments which I have written to give them as law.”
units.Exodus 24:13: Moses rose with Joshua, who attended him, and they went up the mountain of God.
units.Exodus 24:14: They said to the elders, “Remain here until we return to you. Aaron and Hur are with you. If anyone has a dispute, let them approach them.”
units.Exodus 24:15: Moses and Joshua went up the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
units.Exodus 24:16: God’s glory descended on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days. On the seventh day the Lord called Moses from within the cloud.
units.Exodus 24:17: The appearance of the Lord’s glory was like a blazing fire on the mountain’s summit before the sons of Israel.
units.Exodus 24:18: Moses entered the cloud and went up the mountain. He remained there on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

units.Genesis 9:13: I set My bow in the cloud, and it shall be a sign of the covenant between Me and the earth.
units.Genesis 9:14: “And when I gather clouds over the earth, My bow shall appear in the cloud.
units.Genesis 9:15: And I will remember My covenant between Me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall never again become a flood to blot out all flesh.
units.Genesis 9:16: “My bow shall be in the cloud, and I will look upon it and remember the everlasting covenant between Me and every living creature of all flesh upon the earth.”
units.Genesis 9:17: And God said to Noah, “This is the sign of the covenant which I have established between Me and all flesh upon the earth.”

units.Acts 7:55: But he, full of the Holy Spirit, gazed into heaven and saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at God’s right hand.
units.Acts 7:56: He said, “Look, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at God’s right hand.”
units.Acts 7:57: They cried out with a loud voice, stopped their ears, and rushed upon him together.
units.Acts 7:58: They drove him outside the city and began stoning him. The witnesses laid their garments at the feet of a young man called Saul.

units.Acts 26:12: In this pursuit I was traveling to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests,
units.Acts 26:13: when at midday, O king, I saw along the road a light from heaven, brighter than the sun, shining around me and those traveling with me.
units.Acts 26:14: When we had all fallen to the ground, I heard a voice speaking to me in the Hebrew language: ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me? It is hard for you to kick against goads.’
units.Acts 26:15: I said, ‘Who art Thou, Lord?’ The Lord said, ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
units.Acts 26:16: But rise and stand on your feet, for I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you a servant and witness of the things in which you have seen Me and those in which I will appear to you,
units.Acts 26:17: rescuing you from the people and from the Gentiles, to whom I am sending you,
units.Acts 26:18: to open their eyes, so that they may turn from darkness to light and from Satan’s authority to God, so that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an allotted share among those sanctified by faith in Me.’
units.Jeremiah 1:4: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Jeremiah 1:5: Before I formed you in the belly, I know you; before you came out of the womb, I have consecrated you. I have appointed you a prophet to nations.
units.Jeremiah 1:6: I said, O Master Lord! Behold, I do not know how to speak, because I am young.
units.Jeremiah 1:7: The Lord said to me, Do not say, I am young, because you will go to everyone to whom I send you, and you will speak according to everything I command you.
units.Jeremiah 1:8: Do not fear them, because I am with you to rescue you, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 1:9: The Lord stretched out His hand toward me and touched my mouth. The Lord said to me, Behold, I have put My words into your mouth.
units.Jeremiah 1:10: Behold, today I have appointed you over nations and kingdoms, to uproot, demolish, destroy, build and plant.
units.Jeremiah 1:11: The Lord’s word came to me, saying, What do you see, Jeremiah? I said, A nut-wood staff.
units.Jeremiah 1:12: The Lord said to me, You have seen well, because I am watchful over My words to perform them.
units.Jeremiah 1:13: The Lord’s word came to me a second time, saying, What do you see? I said, A cauldron heated from beneath, its face away from the north.
units.Jeremiah 1:14: The Lord said to me, From the north calamities will be kindled upon all who inhabit the land.
units.Jeremiah 1:15: Because behold, I am summoning all the kingdoms from the north of the land, says the Lord. They will come and each set his throne at the forecourts of Jerusalem’s gates, against all her surrounding walls and against all Judah’s cities.
units.Jeremiah 1:16: I will speak to them with judgment concerning all their evil, because they abandoned Me, sacrificed to foreign gods and bowed down to the works of their hands.
units.Jeremiah 1:17: But you, gird your waist, rise and tell them everything I command you. Do not fear them or be terrified before them, because I am with you to rescue you, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 1:18: Behold, on this day I have made you like a fortified city and like a strong bronze wall against all Judah’s kings, its rulers and the people of the land,
units.Jeremiah 1:19: and they will fight you, but they will certainly not prevail against you, because I am with you to rescue you, said the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 15:15: Lord, remember me and visit me and vindicate me against those pursuing me; do not delay. Know how I received reproach concerning Thee
units.Jeremiah 15:16: from those rejecting Thy words. Bring them to an end, and Thy word will become to me rejoicing and my heart’s joy, because Thy name has been called over me, Lord Almighty.
units.Jeremiah 15:17: I did not sit in their gathering as they played, but I was reverent before Thy hand. I sat alone because I was filled with bitterness.
units.Jeremiah 15:18: Why do those grieving me overpower me? My wound is firm; from where will I be healed? It indeed became to me like false water having no faithfulness.
units.Jeremiah 15:19: Therefore thus says the Lord: If you return, I will restore you, and you will stand before Me. If you bring out the honored from the unworthy, you will be as My mouth; and they will turn to you, and you will not turn to them.
units.Jeremiah 15:20: And I will make you to this people like a fortified bronze wall, and they will fight against you but certainly will not prevail against you, because I am with you to save you
units.Jeremiah 15:21: and to rescue you from the hand of evil people, and I will ransom you from the hand of pestilent people.
units.Jeremiah 33:1: At the beginning of the reign of King Jehoiakim son of Josiah, this word came from the Lord:
units.Jeremiah 33:2: Thus said the Lord: Stand in the courtyard of the Lord’s house and deliver an oracle to all the Judeans and all who come to bow down in the Lord’s house—all the words I commanded you to deliver to them. Do not take away a word.
units.Jeremiah 33:3: Perhaps they will hear and turn, each from his evil way, and I will cease from the evils I plan to do to them because of their evil practices.
units.Jeremiah 33:4: And say: Thus said the Lord: If you do not hear Me, walking in My ordinances that I set before your face,
units.Jeremiah 33:5: listening to the words of My servants the prophets whom I send to you from early morning, and have sent—though you did not listen to Me—
units.Jeremiah 33:6: then I will make this house like Shiloh and make the city a curse to all the nations of all the earth.
units.1 Samuel 8:4: Israel’s men gathered and came to Samuel at Armathaim.
units.1 Samuel 8:5: They said to him, “Behold, you have grown old, and your sons do not walk in your way. Now appoint a king over us to judge us like the other nations.”
units.1 Samuel 8:6: The word was evil in Samuel’s eyes when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to the Lord.
units.1 Samuel 8:7: The Lord said to Samuel, “Listen to the people’s voice in whatever they say to you. They have treated Me as nothing so that I should not reign over them; it is not you they have treated as nothing.
units.1 Samuel 8:8: As in all the deeds they have done to Me from the day I brought them up from Egypt until this day, forsaking Me and serving other gods, so they are doing to you as well.
units.1 Samuel 8:9: Now listen to their voice. But solemnly testify to them and report to them the claim of the king who will reign over them.”

units.Deuteronomy 6:5: And you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your strength.
units.Deuteronomy 6:6: And these words, which I command you this day, shall be in your heart and in your soul.
units.Deuteronomy 6:7: And you shall teach them to your sons, and speak of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk in the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
units.Deuteronomy 6:8: And you shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and it shall be immovable before your eyes.
units.Deuteronomy 6:9: And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your houses and of your gates.

units.Psalms 118:98: Thou madest me wiser than my enemies in Thy commandment, for it is mine for ever.
units.Psalms 118:99: I understood more than all who teach me, for Thy testimonies are my meditation.
units.Psalms 118:100: I understood more than elders, for I sought Thy commandments.
units.Psalms 118:101: I restrained my feet from every evil way, so that I might keep Thy words.
units.Psalms 118:102: I did not turn away from Thy judgments, for Thou didst instruct me.
units.Psalms 118:103: How sweet are Thy sayings to my throat, beyond honey and honeycomb to my mouth!

units.Zechariah 5:2: He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a flying sickle, twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.”
units.Zechariah 5:3: He said to me, “This is the curse going out over the whole earth, because every thief will be punished by this with death, and every false swearer will be punished by this with death.

units.Ezekiel 33:21: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the twelfth month, on the fifth of the month, the survivor from Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been captured!”
units.Ezekiel 33:22: The Lord’s hand came upon me in the evening before he arrived, and He opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning. Once my mouth was opened, it was no longer restrained.
units.Ezekiel 33:23: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 33:24: “Son of man, those dwelling in the devastated places upon Israel’s land say, ‘Abraham was one, yet he possessed the land. We are more; the land has been given to us as a possession.’
units.Ezekiel 33:25: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord:
units.Ezekiel 33:27: I live: surely those in the devastated places will fall by the sword. Those in the open plain will be given as food to the field’s beasts, and those in fortified places and caves I will kill with death.
units.Ezekiel 33:28: I will make the land a wilderness; the arrogance of her strength will perish, and Israel’s mountains will be desolate because no one passes through.
units.Ezekiel 33:29: They will know that I am the Lord. I will make their land a wilderness, and it will be desolate because of all the abominations they committed.’
units.Ezekiel 33:30: And you, son of man, your people’s sons talk about you beside the walls and in the houses’ gateways. A man says to his brother, ‘Let us gather and hear what comes from the Lord!’
units.Ezekiel 33:31: They come to you as people assemble and sit before you. They hear your words but certainly will not do them, because falsehood is in their mouth, and their heart follows defilements.
units.Ezekiel 33:32: You become to them like the sound of a sweet-voiced, well-tuned psaltery. They will hear your words but certainly will not do them.
units.Ezekiel 33:33: When it comes, they will say, ‘Behold, it has arrived,’ and know that a prophet was among them.”
units.Ezekiel 37:1: The Lord’s hand came upon me. The Lord brought me out in spirit and set me in the middle of the plain, which was full of human bones.
units.Ezekiel 37:2: He led me all around them, and behold, there were very many upon the plain’s surface, very dry.
units.Ezekiel 37:3: He said to me, ‘Son of man, will these bones live?’ I said, ‘Lord, Thou knowest these things.’
units.Ezekiel 37:4: He said to me, ‘Prophesy over these bones and say to them, Dry bones, hear the Lord’s word:
units.Ezekiel 37:5: Thus says the Lord to these bones: Behold, I am bringing the breath of life into you,
units.Ezekiel 37:6: and I will put sinews upon you, bring flesh upon you, stretch skin over you and put My Spirit into you. You will live and know that I am the Lord.’
units.Ezekiel 37:7: I prophesied as He commanded me. As I prophesied, behold, there was a shaking, and the bones came together, each to its joint.
units.Ezekiel 37:8: I saw, and behold, sinews and flesh grew upon them, and skin came up over them, but there was no breath in them.
units.Ezekiel 37:9: He said to me, ‘Prophesy, son of man! Prophesy to the breath and say to the breath, Thus says the Lord: Come from the four winds and breathe into these dead, and let them live!’
units.Ezekiel 37:10: I prophesied as He commanded me. The breath entered them, and they lived and stood upon their feet, an exceedingly great assembly.
units.Ezekiel 40:1: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the first month, on the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was captured, on that day the Lord’s hand came upon me, and He led me
units.Ezekiel 40:2: in a vision of God into Israel’s land and set me upon a very high mountain. Upon it, opposite, was something like a city’s structure.
units.Ezekiel 40:3: He brought me in there, and behold, a man whose appearance was like gleaming copper. In his hand were a builders’ cord and a measuring reed, and he stood at the gate.
units.Ezekiel 40:4: The man said to me, ‘Have you seen, son of man? See with your eyes, hear with your ears and set in your heart everything I show you, for you have entered here so that it might be shown to you. You will show Israel’s house everything you see.’
