units.Acts 20:17: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and summoned the elders of the Church.
units.Acts 20:18: When they came to him, he said, “You know how I was with you the whole time, from the first day I set foot in Asia,
units.Acts 20:19: serving the Lord with all humility, tears, and trials that came upon me through the plots of the Jews.
units.Acts 20:20: I did not hold back from declaring anything beneficial to you and teaching you publicly and from house to house,
units.Acts 20:21: bearing solemn witness to both Jews and Greeks of repentance toward God and faith in our Lord Jesus.
units.Acts 20:22: And now, look, bound in spirit, I am going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will meet me there,
units.Acts 20:23: except that in every city the Holy Spirit bears witness to me, saying that bonds and afflictions await me.
units.Acts 20:24: But I consider my life of no value to myself, so that I may complete my course and the ministry I received from the Lord Jesus: to bear solemn witness to the good news of God’s grace.
units.Acts 20:25: And now, look, I know that none of you among whom I went about proclaiming the kingdom will see my face again.
units.Acts 20:26: Therefore I testify to you this very day that I am clean from the blood of all,
units.Acts 20:27: for I did not hold back from declaring to you the whole purpose of God.
units.Acts 20:28: Pay attention to yourselves and to all the flock, among whom the Holy Spirit has placed you as overseers, to shepherd the Church of God, which He acquired through His own blood.
units.1 Timothy 4:12: Let no one despise your youth, but become a pattern for believers in word, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
units.1 Timothy 4:13: Until I come, devote yourself to the reading, the exhortation and the teaching.
units.1 Timothy 4:14: Do not neglect the gift in you, which was given to you through prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the council of elders.
units.1 Timothy 4:15: Practice these things; be absorbed in them, so that your progress may be clear to all.
units.1 Timothy 4:16: Pay attention to yourself and to the teaching; continue in them, for by doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
units.Isaiah 50:4: The Lord gives me a tongue of instruction, to know the right time when a word must be spoken. He appointed morning for me; He added an ear for me to hear,
units.Isaiah 50:5: and the Lord’s instruction opens my ears. I do not disobey or contradict.
units.Isaiah 50:6: I have given my back to scourges and my cheeks to slaps. I did not turn my face away from the shame of spitting.
units.Isaiah 50:7: The Lord became my helper; therefore I was not abashed. Instead, I set my face like solid rock and knew that I would certainly not be ashamed.
units.Isaiah 50:8: For the One who justified me draws near. Who is bringing a case against me? Let him stand against me together. Who is bringing a case against me? Let him approach me.
units.Isaiah 50:9: Behold, the Lord helps me. Who will harm me? Behold, all of you will grow old like a garment, and it will devour you like a moth.
units.2 Kings 25:1: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, Nabouchodonosor king of Babylon came with all his force against Jerusalem. He camped against it and built an enclosing wall against it all around.
units.2 Kings 25:2: The city remained under siege until King Sedekias’s eleventh year.
units.2 Kings 25:3: On the ninth of the month the famine grew severe in the city, and there were no loaves for the people of the land.
units.2 Kings 25:4: The city was breached, and all the men of war went out by night by way of the gate between the walls, the one belonging to the king’s garden, with the Chaldeans surrounding the city. He went by the way of the Araba.
units.2 Kings 25:5: The Chaldean force pursued the king and overtook him in Araboth Jericho, and all his force scattered away from him.
units.2 Kings 25:6: They seized the king and brought him to the king of Babylon at Deblatha, and he pronounced judgment upon him.
units.2 Kings 25:7: He slaughtered Sedekias’s sons before his eyes. He blinded Sedekias’s eyes, bound him with fetters, and brought him to Babylon.
units.Numbers 14:26: And the Lord spoke unto Moses and Aaron, saying:
units.Numbers 14:27: How long with this evil congregation? They grumble before Me; I have heard the sons of Israel’s grumbling that they have directed against you.
units.Numbers 14:28: Say to them, I live, says the Lord: I will certainly do to you just as you have spoken into My ears.
units.Numbers 14:29: In this wilderness your bodies shall fall, with your entire registration and those of you counted from twenty years old and upward who grumbled against Me.
units.Numbers 14:30: You shall certainly not enter the land over which I stretched out My hand to settle you upon it, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
units.Numbers 14:31: And I will bring into the land the children whom you said would become plunder, and they shall inherit the land from which you turned away.
units.Numbers 14:32: And your bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
units.Numbers 14:33: But your sons shall live as herders in the wilderness for forty years and bear your whoredom, until your bodies are consumed in the wilderness.
units.Numbers 14:34: According to the number of days you searched out the land—forty days, a day for a year—you shall bear your sins for forty years, and you shall know the fury of My anger.
units.Numbers 14:35: I, the Lord, have spoken. I will certainly do this to this evil congregation that has banded together against Me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
units.Hosea 9:1: Do not rejoice, Israel, or be glad like the peoples, because you prostituted yourself away from your God; you loved gifts on every threshing floor of grain.
units.Hosea 9:2: Threshing floor and winepress did not know them, and wine deceived them.
units.Hosea 9:3: They did not dwell in the Lord’s land; Ephraim dwelt in Egypt, and among the Assyrians they will eat unclean things.
units.Hosea 9:4: They did not pour wine to the Lord or make it pleasant to Him. Their sacrifices are like bread of mourning to them; all who eat them will be defiled, because their loaves for their own lives will not enter the Lord’s house.
units.Hosea 9:5: What will you do on a day of assembly and on the day of the Lord’s festival?
units.Acts 10:9: The next day, while they were traveling and approaching the city, Peter went up onto the roof to pray, about the sixth hour.
units.Acts 10:10: He became hungry and wanted to eat. While they were preparing the food, a trance came upon him.
units.Acts 10:11: He saw heaven opened and something like a large sheet descending, being lowered by its four corners to the earth.
units.Acts 10:12: In it were all the four-footed animals and creeping things of the earth and birds of the sky.
units.Acts 10:13: A voice came to him: “Rise, Peter; slaughter and eat.”
units.Acts 10:14: Peter said, “By no means, Lord, for I have never eaten anything common and unclean.”
units.Acts 10:15: A voice came to him again, a second time: “What God has cleansed, you must not call common.”
units.Acts 10:16: This happened three times, and immediately the object was taken up into heaven.
units.Leviticus 17:10: And any man of the sons of Israel, or of the resident foreigners attached unto you, who eats any blood: I will set My face against the soul that eats the blood, and destroy him from among his people.
units.Leviticus 17:11: For the life of all flesh is its blood, and I have given it unto you upon the altar to make atonement for your lives; for its blood shall make atonement in place of the life.
units.Leviticus 17:12: Therefore I have said unto the sons of Israel: No soul among you shall eat blood; and the resident foreigner attached unto you shall not eat blood.
units.Leviticus 17:13: And any person of the sons of Israel or of the resident foreigners attached to you who hunts a wild animal or bird that may be eaten shall pour out the blood and cover it with earth.
units.Leviticus 17:14: For the life of all flesh is its blood; and I said unto the sons of Israel: You shall eat no blood of any flesh, for the life of all flesh is its blood; whosoever eats it shall be destroyed.
units.Leviticus 17:15: And every soul, whether among the natives or among the resident foreigners, that eats an animal which has died or has been taken by wild beasts, shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening, and shall be clean.
units.Leviticus 17:16: But if he does not wash his garments and does not bathe his body in water, he shall bear his lawless deed.
units.Leviticus 26:14: But if you do not obey Me and do not do these ordinances of Mine,
units.Leviticus 26:15: but disobey them, and your soul is indignant at My judgments, so that you do not do all My commandments, so as to dissolve My covenant,
units.Leviticus 26:16: then I will do this to you: I will bring distress upon you, scab and jaundice that waste your eyes and melt away your life. You shall sow your seeds in vain, and your adversaries shall eat them.
units.Leviticus 26:17: And I will set My face against you, and you shall fall before your enemies. Those who hate you shall pursue you, and you shall flee when no one pursues you.
units.Leviticus 26:18: And if up to this point you do not obey Me, I will discipline you seven times more for your sins.
units.Leviticus 26:19: And I will shatter the arrogance of your pride, and make your heaven iron, and your land as bronze;
units.Leviticus 26:20: and your strength shall be in vain. Your land shall not yield its seed, and the tree of your field shall not yield its fruit.
units.Leviticus 26:21: And if after these things you walk crookedly and will not obey Me, I will add seven blows upon you according to your sins.
units.Leviticus 26:22: And I will send the wild animals of the land against you. They shall devour you, consume your livestock, and make you few, so that your roads become desolate.
units.Leviticus 26:23: And if by these things you are not disciplined, but walk crookedly toward Me,
units.Leviticus 26:24: then I too will walk with you in contrary anger, and I too will strike you seven times in return for your sins.
units.Leviticus 26:25: And I will bring upon you a sword exacting the penalty of the covenant. You shall flee into your cities, and I will send death among you; you shall be handed into enemies’ hands.
units.Leviticus 26:26: When I afflict you with a scarcity of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven and give back your bread by weight. You shall eat and in no wise be filled.
units.Leviticus 26:27: If after these things you do not obey Me, but walk crookedly toward Me,
units.Leviticus 26:28: then I Myself will walk with you in contrary anger, and I will discipline you seven times according to your sins.
units.Leviticus 26:29: And you shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters you shall eat.
units.Leviticus 26:30: And I will lay waste your pillars, and destroy your wooden images made by hand, and place your limbs upon the limbs of your idols; and My soul shall be indignant with you;
units.Leviticus 26:31: and I will make your cities desolate, and lay waste your holy places; and I will in no wise smell the savour of your sacrifices;
units.Leviticus 26:32: and I Myself will desolate your land, and your enemies who dwell in it shall marvel at it.
units.Leviticus 26:33: And I will scatter you among the nations, and the advancing sword shall consume you. Your land shall become desolate, and your cities shall be desolate.
units.Leviticus 26:34: Then the land shall welcome its Sabbaths and all the days of its desolation, and you shall be in your enemies’ land. Then the land shall keep Sabbath and welcome its Sabbaths.
units.Leviticus 26:35: All the days of its desolation it shall keep Sabbath for the Sabbaths it did not keep during your Sabbaths when you inhabited it.
units.Leviticus 26:36: And upon those who remain of you I will bring cowardice into their heart in the land of their enemies; and the sound of a leaf borne along shall pursue them; and they shall flee as those fleeing from war, and fall when none pursues;
units.Leviticus 26:37: and brother shall disregard brother as in war, though no one runs after them. You shall not be able to withstand your enemies.
units.Leviticus 26:38: And you shall perish among the nations, and your enemies’ land shall devour you.
units.Leviticus 26:39: And those who remain of you shall be ruined because of your sins; they shall waste away in the land of their enemies.
units.Leviticus 26:40: And they shall confess their sins and their fathers’ sins, because they transgressed and disregarded Me, and because they walked crookedly before Me.
units.Leviticus 26:41: And I too walked with them in contrary anger, and I will destroy them in their enemies’ land. Then their uncircumcised heart will feel shame, and then they will accept their sins.
units.Leviticus 26:42: And I will remember the covenant of Jacob and the covenant of Isaac, and the covenant of Abraham I will remember; and I will remember the land.
units.Leviticus 26:43: And the land shall be abandoned by them. Then the land shall receive its Sabbaths when it is desolated because of them, and they shall accept their lawless deeds, because they disregarded My judgments and were indignant at My ordinances in their soul.
units.Leviticus 26:44: And yet even so, while they were in their enemies’ land, I did not disregard them or become indignant with them so as to consume them and dissolve My covenant with them, for I am the Lord their God.
units.Leviticus 26:45: And I will remember for them the former covenant, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of a house of slavery, before the nations to be their God. I am the Lord.
units.Isaiah 7:17: But God will bring upon you, upon your people and upon your father’s house days that have not yet come since the day He removed Ephraim from Judah—the king of the Assyrians.”
units.Isaiah 7:18: On that day the Lord will whistle for flies—what rules a part of Egypt’s river—and for the bee that is in the Assyrians’ country,
units.Isaiah 7:19: and they will all come and rest in the country’s ravines, in holes of the rocks, in the caves, in every fissure and in every tree.
units.Isaiah 7:20: On that day the Lord will shave with the great and drunken razor that is beyond the river of the king of the Assyrians—the head and the hair of the feet—and He will remove the beard.
units.Isaiah 7:21: On that day a person will raise a heifer from the cattle and two sheep,
units.Isaiah 7:22: and because they produce very much milk, everyone left upon the land will eat butter and honey.
units.Isaiah 7:23: On that day every place where there are a thousand vines worth a thousand shekels will become fallow ground and thorn.
units.Isaiah 7:24: With missile and arrow they will enter there, because all the land will be fallow ground and thorn.
units.Isaiah 7:25: Every mountain that is plowed will be plowed, and fear will certainly not come there; for from fallow ground and thorn it will become pasture for sheep and a trampling place for cattle.
units.Ezekiel 38:8: After many days he will be prepared, and at the end of years he will come and reach the land turned back from the sword, of those gathered from many nations, upon Israel’s land that had been wholly desolate. This one has come out of nations, and all will dwell in peace.
units.Ezekiel 38:9: You will come up like rain and arrive like a cloud to cover the land; you will be there, with all those around you and many nations with you.
units.Ezekiel 38:10: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: On that day words will rise in your heart, and you will devise evil plans,
units.Ezekiel 38:11: and say, “I will go up against an abandoned land; I will come upon those resting quietly and dwelling in peace, all living in a land with no wall or bars, and they have no doors,”
units.Ezekiel 38:12: to take plunder and strip their spoils, to turn your hand against the desolate land that was inhabited and against a nation gathered from many nations, acquiring possessions, dwelling upon the earth’s navel.
units.Ezekiel 38:13: Saba, Daidan, Carthaginian merchants and all their villages will say to you, “Are you coming for plunder, to plunder and strip spoils? Have you gathered your assembly to take silver and gold, carry away possessions and strip spoils?”
units.Jeremiah 11:6: And the Lord said to me: Read these words in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem, saying: Hear the words of this covenant and do them.
units.Jeremiah 11:8: And they did not do them.
units.Jeremiah 11:9: And the Lord said to me: A conspiracy was found among Judah’s men and those dwelling in Jerusalem.
units.Jeremiah 11:10: They returned to the injustices of their earlier fathers, who would not listen to My words; and behold, they walk after foreign gods to serve them. And the house of Israel and the house of Judah shattered My covenant that I established with their fathers.
units.Jeremiah 11:11: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am bringing evils upon this people from which they will not be able to escape; and they will cry to Me, and I will not listen to them.
units.Jeremiah 11:12: And Judah’s cities and those dwelling in Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to whom they burn incense. Will those gods save them in the time of their evils?
units.Jeremiah 11:13: For your gods were according to the number of your cities, Judah; and according to the number of Jerusalem’s exits you set up altars to burn incense to Baal.
units.2 Kings 21:1: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Opsiba.
units.2 Kings 21:2: He did evil in the Lord’s eyes, according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord removed before the Israelites.
units.2 Kings 21:3: He rebuilt the high places his father Hezekiah had pulled down, erected an altar for Baal, and made groves as Ahab king of Israel had done. He bowed down to all heaven’s host and served them.
units.2 Kings 21:4: He built an altar in the Lord’s house, as He had said, ‘In Jerusalem I shall place My name.’
units.2 Kings 21:5: He built an altar for all heaven’s host in the two courts of the Lord’s house.
units.2 Kings 21:6: He led his sons through fire, practiced divination from sounds, read omens, and appointed a charmer and knowing ones. He did much evil in the Lord’s eyes, provoking Him.
units.2 Kings 21:7: He placed the carved image of the grove in the house of which the Lord said to David and his son Solomon, ‘In this house and in Jerusalem, which I chose from all Israel’s tribes, I shall place My name there for ever.
units.2 Kings 21:8: I shall no longer shake Israel’s foot from the land I gave their fathers, for those who keep everything I commanded according to the whole commandment My servant Moses commanded them.’
units.2 Kings 21:9: But they did not listen. Manasseh led them astray to do evil in the Lord’s eyes beyond the nations whom the Lord obliterated before the Israelites.
units.2 Kings 21:10: The Lord spoke through His servants the prophets:
units.2 Kings 21:11: ‘Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these evil abominations, worse than everything the Amorite before him did, and has also caused Judah to sin through their idols,
units.2 Kings 21:12: not so! Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Behold, I am bringing disasters upon Jerusalem and Judah, so that both ears of everyone hearing shall ring.
units.Daniel 9:4: I prayed to the Lord God and confessed, saying, “Behold, Lord, Thou art the great, strong, and fearsome God, keeping the covenant and mercy for those who love Thee and guard Thy commands:
units.Daniel 9:5: we have sinned, done wrong, acted impiously, fallen away, and transgressed Thy commandments and judgments,
units.Daniel 9:6: and have not listened to Thy servants the prophets, to what they spoke in Thy name to our kings, our rulers, our fathers, and every nation upon the earth.
units.Daniel 9:7: Righteousness belongs to Thee, Lord, but shame of face to us as on this day—to the people of Judah, those dwelling in Jerusalem, and all the people Israel, near and far, in all the countries where Thou didst scatter them because of the trespass they committed before Thee.
units.Daniel 9:8: Master, shame of face belongs to us, to our kings, rulers, and fathers, because we have sinned against Thee.
units.Daniel 9:9: To the Lord belong righteousness and mercy, for we have fallen away from Thee
units.Daniel 9:10: and have not listened to the voice of the Lord our God, to follow Thy law that Thou didst set before Moses and us through Thy servants the prophets.
units.Daniel 9:11: All Israel abandoned Thy law and fell away, refusing to hear Thy voice. The curse and oath written in the law of Moses, God’s servant, came upon us, because we sinned against Him.
units.Daniel 9:12: He established for us His commands, all He spoke against us and against our judges, all Thou didst judge for us, bringing great calamities upon us, such as had not occurred under heaven as occurred in Jerusalem.
units.Daniel 9:13: According to what is written in Moses’ covenant, all the calamities came upon us. Yet we did not seek the face of the Lord our God by departing from our sins and understanding Thy righteousness, Lord.
units.Daniel 9:14: The Lord God kept watch over the calamities and brought them upon us, for the Lord our God is righteous in everything He may do, and we did not listen to His voice.
units.Jeremiah 7:25: From the day their fathers left Egypt’s land until this day, I sent out to you all My servants the prophets by day and at dawn, and I sent them.
units.Jeremiah 7:26: And they did not hear Me, and their ear did not attend, and they hardened their neck beyond their fathers.
units.Jeremiah 7:27–28: And you will say this word to them: This is the nation that did not hear the Lord’s voice or accept instruction; faithfulness failed from their mouth.
units.Jeremiah 7:29: Shear your head and cast it away, and take up a lament on your lips, because the Lord rejected and thrust away the generation doing these things.
units.Jeremiah 7:30: For Judah’s sons did evil before Me, says the Lord; they set their abominations in the house over which My name has been called, to defile it.
units.Jeremiah 7:31: And they built Topheth’s altar, which is in the ravine of the son of Hinnom, to burn up their sons and daughters in fire, which I did not command them and did not conceive in My heart.
units.Jeremiah 7:32: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and they will no longer say Topheth’s Altar or Ravine of the Son of Hinnom, but Ravine of the Slain; and they will bury in Topheth because there is no space.
units.Jeremiah 7:33: And this people’s dead will be food for heaven’s birds and the earth’s wild beasts, and there will be no one to drive them off.
units.Jeremiah 7:34: And I will stop the sound of those rejoicing and the sound of those glad, the voice of bridegroom and the voice of bride, from Judah’s cities and Jerusalem’s thoroughfares, because the whole land will become a desolation.
units.Deuteronomy 32:19: And the Lord saw, and was jealous, and was provoked by the anger of His sons and daughters.
units.Deuteronomy 32:20: And He said, I will turn My face from them, and show what shall befall them at the last; for they are a perverse generation, sons in whom is no faithfulness.
units.Deuteronomy 32:21: They made Me jealous with that which is no god; they provoked Me to anger with their idols. And I will make them jealous with that which is no nation; with a nation without understanding will I provoke them to anger.
units.Deuteronomy 32:22: For a fire has been kindled out of My wrath; it shall burn unto Hades beneath, devour the earth and its produce, and set ablaze the foundations of the mountains.
units.Deuteronomy 32:23: I will gather evils against them, and spend My arrows upon them.
units.Deuteronomy 32:24: They shall waste away with hunger, and be devoured by birds, and suffer incurable backward-bending spasms; I will send against them the teeth of wild beasts, with the fury of things that crawl upon the ground.
units.Deuteronomy 32:25: Without, the sword shall bereave them; and from the inner chambers, terror: the young man together with the maiden, the nursing child with the aged elder.
units.Deuteronomy 32:26: I said, I will scatter them; I will make their remembrance cease from among men,
units.Deuteronomy 32:27: were it not for the wrath of enemies, lest they endure long, and lest the adversaries join in the attack; lest they say, Our hand is exalted, and the Lord has not done all these things.
units.Jeremiah 19:1: Then the Lord said to me: Go and acquire a molded earthenware jar, and bring some of the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests.
units.Jeremiah 19:2: And go out to the burial ground of the sons of their children, which is before the Charsith Gate, and read there all the words that I speak to you.
units.Jeremiah 19:3: And say to them: Hear the Lord’s word, kings of Judah, men of Judah, inhabitants of Jerusalem, and those entering these gates. Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Behold, I am bringing evils upon this place, so that both ears of everyone hearing them will ring.
units.Jeremiah 19:4: Because they abandoned Me and alienated this place, burning incense in it to foreign gods whom neither they nor their fathers knew; and Judah’s kings filled this place with innocent blood,
units.Jeremiah 19:5: and built high places for Baal to burn their sons in fire, things I did not command or speak of or conceive in My heart.
units.Jeremiah 19:6: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and this place will no longer be called Collapse or the Burial Ground of the Son of Hinnom, but the Burial Ground of Slaughter.
units.Jeremiah 19:7: And I will slaughter Judah’s counsel and Jerusalem’s counsel in this place, and cast them down by the sword before their enemies and into the hands of those seeking their lives. I will give their dead as food to the birds of the heavens and the beasts of the earth.
units.Jeremiah 19:8: And I will make this city a ruin and a hissing. Everyone passing through it will look gloomy and hiss over its whole wound.
units.Jeremiah 19:9: And they will eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and each will eat his neighbor’s flesh in the encirclement and siege with which their enemies will besiege them.
units.Jeremiah 19:10: And smash the jar before the eyes of the men going out with you,
units.Jeremiah 19:11: and say: Thus says the Lord: This is how I will smash this people and this city, as an earthenware vessel is smashed that cannot be healed again.
units.Jeremiah 19:12: This is what I will do, says the Lord, to this place and its inhabitants, so that this city is made like the collapsing place.
units.Jeremiah 19:13: And Jerusalem’s houses and the houses of Judah’s kings will be like the collapsing place of uncleannesses, in all the houses where they burned incense upon their roofs to all the host of the heavens and poured drink offerings to foreign gods.
units.Deuteronomy 4:25: And if you beget sons and sons’ sons, and you have remained long upon the land, and act lawlessly, and make a graven likeness of anything, and do evil before the Lord your God, to provoke Him to anger,
units.Deuteronomy 4:26: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that you shall surely perish from the land whither you pass over the Jordan to inherit it. You shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall be utterly blotted out.
units.Deuteronomy 4:27: And the Lord shall scatter you among all the nations, and you shall be left few in number among the nations whither the Lord shall bring you.
units.Deuteronomy 4:28: And there you shall serve other gods, the works of men’s hands, wood and stone, which shall neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
units.Deuteronomy 4:29: And there you shall seek the Lord your God, and shall find Him, when you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul, in your distress.
units.Deuteronomy 4:30: And all these things shall find you in the latter days, and you shall return unto the Lord your God, and hearken unto His voice.
units.Deuteronomy 4:31: For the Lord your God is a merciful God; He will not forsake you, neither will He destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which He sware unto them.
units.2 Kings 23:13: The king defiled the house facing Jerusalem, to the right of Mount Mosoath, which Solomon king of Israel had built for Astarte, the Sidonians’ offensive thing, for Chamos, Moab’s offensive thing, and for Molchol, the Ammonites’ abomination.
units.2 Kings 23:14: He shattered the pillars, destroyed the groves, and filled their sites with human bones.
units.2 Kings 23:15: Moreover, he tore down the altar at Bethel, the high place Jeroboam son of Nabat had made, who caused Israel to sin—both that altar and the high place. He shattered its stones, reduced it to dust, and burned the grove.
units.2 Kings 23:16: Josiah turned aside and saw the tombs there in the city. He sent and took the bones from the tombs, burned them on the altar, and defiled it, according to the Lord’s word which the man of God spoke while Jeroboam stood at the festival beside the altar. Turning, he lifted his eyes toward the tomb of the man of God who had spoken these words.
units.2 Kings 23:17: He said, ‘What is that rocky marker I see?’ The city’s men told him, ‘It is the man of God who came out of Judah and proclaimed these words which he proclaimed against Bethel’s altar.’
units.2 Kings 23:18: He said, ‘Leave it alone. Let no one move his bones.’ His bones were spared together with the bones of the prophet who came from Samaria.
units.2 Kings 23:19: Josiah also removed all the high-place houses in Samaria’s cities which Israel’s kings had made to provoke the Lord. He carried out in them all the works he had carried out at Bethel.
units.2 Kings 23:20: He sacrificed all the priests of the high places who were there upon the altars, and burned human bones upon them. Then he returned to Jerusalem.
units.Ezekiel 36:1: “And you, son of man, prophesy concerning Israel’s mountains and say to Israel’s mountains, ‘Hear the Lord’s word:
units.Ezekiel 36:2: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Because the enemy said over you, “Well done! Everlasting wildernesses have become our possession,”
units.Ezekiel 36:3: therefore prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Because you were dishonored and hated by those around you, so that you became a possession for the remaining nations, and you became a topic on people’s tongues and a reproach to nations,
units.Ezekiel 36:4: therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the Lord’s word! Thus says the Lord to the mountains, hills, ravines, torrents, devastated and destroyed places, and abandoned cities, which became plunder and a trampling place for the remaining nations all around:
units.Ezekiel 36:5: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Surely in the fire of My wrath I have spoken against the remaining nations and all Idumea, because they gave My land to themselves as a possession with rejoicing, dishonoring lives so as to destroy through plunder.
units.Ezekiel 36:6: Therefore prophesy over Israel’s land and say to the mountains, hills, ravines and valleys, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I have spoken in My jealousy and My wrath because you bore the nations’ reproaches.
units.Ezekiel 36:7: Therefore I will raise My hand against the nations around you; these will receive their own dishonor.
units.Jeremiah 21:5: and I Myself will fight you with outstretched hand and mighty arm, with fury, anger, and great indignation.
